summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Qualister Ventas prototype. Login functionality works correctly with proper credential validation and UI changes. Tarifario shows correct initial count (7 equipos). Edit and Delete CRUD operations work correctly. However, CREATE functionality has a critical bug where the form doesn't close after submission and equipment is not added to the list.

critical_bugs.issue: Form sheet does not close after clicking 'Agregar equipo' button. The equipment is not added to the list and count remains unchanged.
steps_to_reproduce: 4. Fill required fields (codigo, magnitud, equipo, precioMXN)
6. Form remains open and count doesn't increase
critical_bugs.expected_behavior: Form should close, equipment should be added to list, count should increase by 1, and success toast should appear
critical_bugs.actual_behavior: Form remains open with overlay blocking all interactions, equipment not added, count unchanged
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot add new equipment to the tarifario. Form overlay blocks all other interactions until page is refreshed (which resets the session).
critical_bugs.note: Edit and Delete functionality work correctly, suggesting the issue is specific to the Create flow or form validation for new equipment

passed_tests: Login with empty fields shows correct error message
Login with incorrect credentials (test@test.com / 1234) shows error and does not navigate
Login with correct credentials (ventas@qualister.mx / ventas2025) successfully navigates to /ventas/dashboard with toast notification
Login UI: No subtitle below company name 'Qualister Laboratorio de Metrología'
Login UI: Business description 'Laboratorio de calibración y metrología: temperatura, humedad, RF y magnitudes eléctricas' appears in right panel
Login UI: Hint shows Ventas profile credentials correctly
Tarifario shows exactly 7 equipments with count '7 de 7 equipos'
Tarifario displays equipment grouped by Magnitud and Equipo
Tarifario Edit functionality: Form opens, allows changes, closes after submission
Tarifario Delete functionality: Confirmation dialog appears, deletion works, count decreases correctly (7→6)
Navigation to Tarifario from Dashboard works correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix the critical bug in Tarifario Create Equipment functionality. The form submission for creating new equipment is not working - form doesn't close and equipment is not added to the list. The issue is in /app/frontend/src/pages/Tarifario.js lines 537-548 (TarifaFormSheet for nuevo). Debug why the onGuardar callback is not being triggered or why setNuevo(false) is not closing the form. Note that Edit and Delete work correctly, so the issue is specific to the Create flow.

success_percentage.tarifario_create: 0% (critical bug - form doesn't close, equipment not added)
